name: Escape Freezer
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Tap wall painting to check clue.
Tap wall safe handle to inspect it.
Tap torn blueprint to reveal code shapes.
Tap vent to drop a key.
Tap kitten to move it near freezer.
Tap guard’s rifle to reflect laser blast.
Tap flask to pour hot water and melt ice.
Tap piggy bank to break it open.
Tap lock and enter code (2-3-1) to free girl.
